entry.title: MongoDB Extension for Hibernate ORM is Now GA | MongoDB Blog
entry.summary: The MongoDB Extension for Hibernate ORM is now generally available, giving Java teams a production-ready way to use familiar Hibernate APIs with MongoDB’s document model. It is a first-party, open-sou
entry.content: The MongoDB Extension for Hibernate ORM is now generally available, giving Java teams a production-ready way to use familiar Hibernate APIs with MongoDB’s document model. It is a first-party, open-source library that enables Java applications to use MongoDB as the backing database via the Hibernate ORM. The extension allows Java developers to enjoy the same experience with MongoDB, reducing the friction for those who want to switch.

entry.content: A customer saw an extra ~32 ms on simple SELECT queries after idle periods. We traced it to unbatched Native protocol metadata packets overflowing a reset TCP congestion window, reproduced it with network namespaces, and fixed it by batching them.

entry.title: Perplexity's New Late-Interaction Models Meet Qdrant's 21x Vector Compression | Qdrant - Vector Search Engine
entry.summary: A number in a financial report needs its row, column, and unit to mean anything. A chart needs its labels. When you build search over PDFs, that context is part of what you want to retrieve.Perplexity
entry.content: A number in a financial report needs its row, column, and unit to mean anything. A chart needs its labels. When you build search over PDFs, that context is part of what you want to retrieve.Perplexity released pplx-embed-v2-late, two late interaction models that search document pages as images. The model embeds the page image, including its tables, charts, and layout. You can skip the optical character recognition (OCR) step and search the page as it appears.
